messages.subject: Executive Candidate Introduction | Dubai | Corporate Affairs, ESG & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Advantis HR Team,

I am reaching out through your current official contact address after an earlier delivery failure. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive operations.

I am internationally mobile and particularly interested in Dubai and wider GCC opportunities at Director, Head, Country and senior strategic level across external affairs, sustainability, partnerships, business development and country operations.

Please find my executive CV attached for review and consideration for suitable current or upcoming mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
